Desk: chip 'Illustration. Generic car with no brand mark', small federal recall card (rows illegible at phone size), wooden stamp; car-icon grid fills row by row from 2 to 8 rows; caption 'that could affect nearly thirty eight hundred cars.'

Grid complete at 10 by 8 icons. A straight blue arm with no elbow enters at 26.4 holding the stamp and carries a ghosted 'Nearly 3,800 vehicles' tag that lands beside the card by 26.8. The arm crosses the icon grid.
Tag pinned and legible: 'Nearly 3,800 vehicles, 3,791 potentially affected in the record'. 'Software recall' stamp mark on the card overlaps the 3,791 row. Arm withdraws right by 27.6; hold.

Grid hold to 28.2, cut at 28.4 to a wide highway. Chip 'Illustration. The recall wording, not a recorded event'. Car enters from left; green blob patches on road; quote card fading in; caption 'The recall says the software may let a car slow,'.

Car travels mid-frame left to right over green patches of ambiguous identity. Quote card legible: 'The software may allow the vehicle to slow and then drive into standing water on higher speed roadways.' Wheels sit just above the caption band.
Car continues and green patches pass behind. Red brake lights at 30.6 to 30.8; a grey water band starts at the right edge of the road at 30.8; streetlamp scrolls in.
Car slowing with brake lights on toward a flat grey water slab at right with a hard edge; quote card and caption unchanged; streetlamp passes.
Car nears the water slab; caption gone at 32.6. Cut at 32.8 to a medium side view of the large finished white car with sensor dome and spoked wheels, quote card above.
Medium side view; headlamp glow; grey water slab ahead at right with a hard vertical edge; caption 'then drive into standing water on higher speed roads.'
Water reaches the front wheel with blocky rectangular seams near it; 'may' highlighted amber on the quote card from 34.2; spray streaks at 34.6 to 34.8; no crash.
Car in standing water with spray lines and reflection streaks. A vertical seam in the water band mid-car is visible. Car keeps rolling, no stop shown.
Same medium hold in water with spray; a darker rectangular band with hard edges under the car (seam); caption unchanged; no crash or stop.

Cut to enlarged recall card on desk. Remedy row 'The remedy is currently under development.' highlights amber from 37.4 and is legible. 'Software recall' stamp overlaps 3,791. Caption 'The federal record says the remedy is currently under development.'
Hold on the record card with remedy row highlighted; at 38.6 a blue-sleeved hand with a pen enters lower right; caption unchanged.
Slight push-in. Two stiff blue arms, pen and stamp, cross the card diagonally. The pen covers the remedy row text so 'under development' is partly occluded.
Stamp arm rises to the remedy row and presses an 'Under development' stamp at 40.6 to 40.8; both arms still occlude the remedy text.

Stamp mark on remedy row partly hidden by the pen arm to 41.4. Cut at 41.6 to a lot with four small cars, April calendar and 'Vehicle maps' signs on a wire gantry. Caption 'As an interim step, Waymo tightened its weather limits,'.
Static lot hold: four small white cars in bays (each about one eighth of frame width), calendar, maps sign, skyline, trees; nothing moves.
'Weather limits tightened' tag with a rain-cloud icon slides in from left along the wire and pins by 43.4; cars static.
Fully static held tableau of the lot, tags and signs for all five samples; caption 'As an interim step, Waymo tightened its weather limits,'.
Caption gap at 45.4; slight reframe at 45.6; new caption 'and every affected car had the update by April twentieth.'; cars still small.
Calendar page flips to show 'April 20' (page lifting 46.2 to 46.6), legible at phone size; cars static.
Hold on 'April 20' calendar and weather tag; at 47.8 a small check circle appears above the first car.
White checkmarks appear over each car in sequence; 'Vehicle maps updated' check on the sign at 48.6 to 48.8.
Hold with all four cars and the maps sign checked; caption ends by 49.8.

Cut to airport curb. Chip 'Illustration. A generic airport ride, not the flood cars'. Phone with route and 'Arriving'; plane-and-car pickup sign; white car parked in bay; caption 'So the airport ride is open,'.
The car's rear door swings open 51.2 to 51.8, showing a dark beige interior with no person visible; bench, teal suitcase and pole behind.
Door-open hold at the curb. At 52.8 a reframe to a wider lower view: car smaller in the upper third, grass verge and grey wedge at the bottom.
Wider curb shot held with door open, car about 40 percent of width; grass and grey wedge below; caption 'and the federal record lists the flood remedy'.
A record slip slides in from left 54.2 to 54.6: 'Federal recall record, Remedy, The remedy is currently under development.' with 'Under development' stamp, legible just above the caption.
